verdict.rationale: Groq documents an OpenAI-compatible endpoint: swap `base_url` to `https://api.groq.com/openai/v1` and pass the API key (groq-docs-2, groq-docs-25, groq-docs-33), so any OpenAI-compatible agent or framework can be pointed at it. Its llms.txt indexes at least one first-party third-party integration page (JigsawStack), which suggests an integrations section exists. Remote MCP tool use (groq-docs-35) and an official MCP server page (groq-probe-4) add agent-facing plumbing. The evidence does not show named, dedicated guides for coding agents or mainstream agent frameworks, so plugging in mostly relies on generic OpenAI compatibility. Missing for 10: explicit first-party integration guides for specific coding agents (e.g. IDE/CLI agents) and agent frameworks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of those integrations working.
